assets.title: 从秘书到专业助理
assets.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create a polished, realistic high fidelity Chinese mobile Feishu interaction design board for a private personal AI companion product called 伴随. This is a product interaction design deliverable, not a marketing poster. Landscape 8:5 composition, ideally 2400x1500. Warm off-white canvas #F5F4F0, almost-black typography, precise muted teal #24766B product accents. Put THREE evenly spaced front-facing phone-screen mockups, large enough that the simplified Chinese text is crisp and legible. Thin subtle dark outlines and very small corner radius; screens dominate the board. White Feishu chat background, familiar top navigation with back arrow, bot avatar/name and small “机器人”, quiet timestamp, native blue user chat bubble on right, bot messages on left, white interactive cards with hairline gray borders, teal/pale-teal card header, plain native-looking controls. Don't redesign Feishu as our own full app; the Companion experience lives INSIDE bot chat messages/cards. Compact input bar and native bot menu at bottom. Secretary avatar a simple teal loop glyph on cream; Quant bot avatar a simple blue chart glyph, distinct. Elegant Chinese sans serif, generous clear spacing, subtle dividers, clean alignment. No fake dashboards inside chat, no decorative 3D, no gradient glass, no huge terminal text, no percentages, no English slogans. Top board title, short subtitle; above each phone a numbered step label; bottom small external caption per phone. Use only the requested UI content, simplify supporting text to fit; preserve exact key labels and task title. Small footer “伴随 · 飞书交互 V2 / 方案效果图 · 非实机 / 示例数据”.
Board title “01 / 从秘书到专业助理”; subtitle “自然发现需求，交接同一件事，不必重新解释”.
Phone1 step “1  秘书提出建议”, title “伴随秘书”. User bubble “这周继续帮我看量化研究”. Bot text “这类研究越来越多，要不要招一位量化助理长期跟进？”. Card title “招募量化助理”; short responsibility “专注策略验证、回测与研究整理”; divider then “准备交接” / task “验证低换手选股假设” / “相关研究资料与已确认约束”. Primary button “招募并交接”, secondary “继续由你做”. Bottom menu exactly “我的任务　记一下　助理”. Caption outside phone “临时小任务由秘书自己安排”.
Phone2 step “2  开通并完成交接”, same secretary chat. Card title “量化助理已就位”, small success icon; text “平台开通与收发核验完成”; task row “验证低换手选股假设”; concise rows “任务与资料已交接” and “秘书继续关注进度”. Primary button “和量化助理聊”; secondary text button “查看交接”. Below card quiet bot line “你仍然可以随时直接找我。” Bottom same3menu. Caption outside “需要扫码时保留进度，完成后继续”.
Phone3 step “3  在独立会话继续”, title “量化助理” distinct blue avatar. Bot text “秘书已把这项研究交给我，我会沿用已确认的要求。”. Native task card title “验证低换手选股假设”; pill “未完成”; short “下一步：确认样本与交易成本”; button “查看任务”. User bubble “先做近五年，算上交易成本”. Bot short receipt “已记入这项研究，按这个范围继续。”. Bottom menu “当前任务　我的任务　找秘书”. Caption outside “打开的是独立机器人，同一任务接着做”.

Board title “02 / 进度、补充与交付”; subtitle “知道做到哪一步，只在需要你时出现”.
All phones title “量化助理”, same task “验证低换手选股假设”. Bottom native menu “当前任务　我的任务　找秘书”.
Phone1 label “4  看得到正在做什么”. Native card pale-teal header “任务进展”, bold task title, green pill “运行中”, small “刚刚更新”. Vertical three-row plain stage list “✓ 已整理研究假设” / “● 正在校验历史样本” / “○ 下一步：计算交易成本”. Smaller concise paragraph “已找到可用样本，正在检查缺失数据。”. Native button “补充要求”; secondary “找秘书”. Outside caption “更新原卡，显示真实阶段与最近时间”.
Phone2 label “5  只补必要的信息”. Bot short line “样本范围还需要你定一下。”. Native form card header “需要你补充”, bold task title, amber pill “未完成 · 待你补充”. Field label “研究区间” native dropdown selected “近五年　⌄”. Field label “补充要求（选填）” native multiline field text “排除上市不足一年的股票”. Primary “提交并继续”, secondary “稍后再说”. Small inline validation/receipt area “提交后会回显并继续这项研究”. Outside caption “表单就在聊天里，不跳陌生网页”.
Phone3 label “6  成果交付后还能继续”. Native completed card header “研究已完成”, task title, teal success pill “已完成”. Brief text “假设、样本范围与回测限制已整理进报告。”. Divider, two buttons “继续这项研究” and “请秘书汇总”. BELOW card a separate native Feishu FILE message with PDF document icon and exact filename “低换手研究报告.pdf”, line “1.8 MB　可预览”. User bubble “请秘书把结论汇总给我”. Bot “已交给秘书，保留这项研究的记录。”. Outside caption “文件原生预览；回秘书也不重建任务”.

Board title “03 / 查任务与随手记”; subtitle “轻入口固定，深入时再展开”.
All phones title “伴随秘书”, bottom native menu “我的任务　记一下　助理”.
Phone1 label “7  一眼看清所有任务”. Chat interactive card header “我的任务”. Native dropdown “角色：全部　⌄”. Three native status buttons “运行中 2” (selected pale teal), “未完成 4”, “已完成 2”. Thin divider. Quiet bottom “本页 2 项 · 刚刚更新” and button “刷新”. Outside caption “默认全部角色，状态可切换”.

Primary “和负责人聊”, secondary “补充要求”. Below card short bot line “你也可以直接在这里问我进度。”. Outside caption “看进度不必跳转，深入讨论才去助理会话”.
Phone3 label “9  记一下，不必立刻办”. User bubble “这篇文章周末想再看看”. Native form card header “记一下”. Text input label “内容” with multiline sample “周末看看这篇关于研究方法的文章”. Input “链接（选填）” show “已粘贴链接”. Primary button “保存”. Beneath card a small clean saved-receipt message with check icon “已保存到资料”, secondary button “交给秘书处理”. Caption outside “先存下，默认不创建任务；图片文件可直接发”.

Board title “04 / 解雇助理，工作留下”; subtitle “角色可以来去，任务、记忆和成果持续积累”.
All phones title “伴随秘书”, same teal avatar and bottom native menu “我的任务　记一下　助理”.
Phone1 label “10  直接告诉秘书”. User bubble “量化助理先不用了，你接回来”. Bot short reply “我会先接回任务和资料，再移除这个角色。”. Native card title “正在准备交接”; plain stages “✓ 已停止新任务分配” / “● 正在核对任务、记忆与成果” / “○ 下一步：请你确认交接清单”. Small footnote inside “运行中的工作会先进入可交接状态”. Outside caption “先准备具体交接，不先删除资料”.
Phone2 label “11  核对后，一次确认”. Native card title “量化助理 · 交接清单”; three spaced rows “2 项未完成任务” / “8 条相关记忆” / “3 份研究成果”. Task preview “验证低换手选股假设” and “补充回测样本”. Secondary text link “查看全部交接内容”. Small divider paragraph “任务交给秘书，记忆保留出处；研究成果继续可查。”. Primary full-width button “并回秘书并移除角色”; secondary “暂时保留”. Outside caption “记忆去重入库，专业知识按需调用”.
Phone3 label “12  并回后继续做事”. Native success card title “工作已并回秘书”; green check icon and “角色已退出派单入口”. Compact rows “任务与资料已交接” / “飞书机器人已停用”. Below another task mini-card title “验证低换手选股假设”; pill “未完成”; owner row “负责人　伴随秘书”; button “继续这项任务”. Quiet note “历史会话仍可查看”. Outside caption “若平台停用失败，单独提示待处理并可重试”.
